Apple confirmed today at its "Surprise and Shine" event that iPadOS 27 will launch in just a few days, on September 14. Here's the list of supported devices.

iPadOS 27 launches September 14

Apple today unveiled the iPhone Duo, its first foldable iPhone, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.

In addition to the new hardware, Apple also confirmed the release date for iPadOS 27, which was first introduced at WWDC26.

Like iOS 27, the headlining feature of iPadOS 27 is the new Siri AI, powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence and Apple Foundation Models, with Apple partnering with Google and its Gemini models.

The revamped assistant is designed to offer a more modern LLM-like experience, using your personal context to provide more relevant, deeper answers. Siri can also search the web for information and synthesize a complete, useful response from that.

iPadOS 27 also brings welcome adjustments to the Liquid Glass interface, along with performance improvements for many system apps, and more.

iPadOS 27 is compatible with the following iPad models:

  • iPad Pro (M4 and later)
  • iPad Pro 12.9-inch (4th generation and later)
  • iPad Pro 11-inch (2nd generation and later)
  • iPad Air 13-inch (M2 and later)
  • iPad Air 11-inch (M2, M3, and M4)
  • iPad Air 11-inch (4th generation and later)
  • iPad (A16)
  • iPad (9th generation and later)
  • iPad mini (A17 Pro)
  • iPad mini (6th generation)

Notably, some of the most advanced new Siri AI features will be limited to iPads with an M4 or later chip and at least 12GB of RAM.
